summary: The locked timing record covers 12 experiments split evenly between compute-bound and synthesis-only work. Its duration is concentrated in one synthesis-only entry; compute-period GPU duty cycle and parallel-runner eligibility remain unobservable.
bottlenecks_identified: The synthesis-only ARC generic state-key reachability invariant and full-roster A/B forms the dominant wall-time concentration, with no internal stage timings to localize its cost.

The displayed compute-bound order is the Exp6426-readiness-gated constraint-saturation factor task, the task-scoped runtime receipt contract, then the V553 capstone. Readiness is the only recorded context for the leader; its active-time cause is absent.
The device monitor captured an idle instant while the locked task-level idle indicator is false. Without synchronized samples across task lifetimes, accelerator duty cycle cannot be measured.
No data available this milestone states loaded-model concurrency or runner selection, leaving no factual basis for a DualGPURunner failure finding.
improvements_suggested: Add monotonic phase timing, resumable checkpoints, and a deterministic CPU sharding-and-merge path for independent cases in the long synthesis invariant and roster A/B workflow.
Capture task-correlated GPU utilization throughout every compute-bound task, with timestamps tied to task start and finish.
Emit loaded-model concurrency and runner-selection receipts, selecting DualGPURunner only for simultaneous multi-model execution.
Record readiness-gate wait separately from active execution so dependency delay is not conflated with compute time.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Instrument and checkpoint the synthesis-only ARC reachability and full-roster A/B phases, then shard independent cases across CPU workers.
Persist task-scoped GPU samples across each compute-bound execution window.
Persist model-concurrency and runner-dispatch receipts, with conditional DualGPURunner routing for parallel multi-model tasks.
meta_reflection: The evidence is sufficient to locate wall-time concentration but insufficient to assign its internal cause or score accelerator use. A future record should separate gate wait from execution and align phase, device, concurrency, and dispatch events on one task timeline.
